sloka: ततः शोणितदिग्धाङ्गः प्रहारैर्जर्जरीकृतः ।फुल्लाशोक इवाभाति पुष्पके राक्षसाधिपः ।। ७.२१.३४ ॥
transliteration: tataḥ śoṇitadigdhāṅgaḥ prahārairjarjarīkṛtaḥ ।phullāśoka ivābhāti puṣpake rākṣasādhipaḥ ।। 7.21.34 ॥

translations.english: Then, the lord of Rakshasas, Ravana, with his limbs smeared with blood and wounded by the blows, appeared on his Pushpaka chariot like a blooming Ashoka tree.
